remarks:
This .85+/- acre parcel on Damon Hill Road offers a simple creekfront setting with approximately 250 feet of frontage along Hatch Creek. Mostly cleared and easy to access, the property is well-suited for a camper, weekend use, or a quiet place to spend time outdoors near the water.
The land includes electric service on site, an existing well, a detached garage, and a former homesite area that may offer useful space for parking, storage, or setting up a seasonal retreat. The open ground gives you room to place a camper and enjoy the creek, while a small wooded section on the north end adds some shade and natural character.
Hatch Creek runs along the edge of the property, creating a peaceful backdrop for fishing, relaxing, and spending time outside. The setting feels rural without being far removed, with Sinclairville’s local services and village amenities just a short drive away.
facts: Irregular Lot, Rural Lot, Level, Stream Creek
